_comment: Paste the object below into the catalog's registry.json plugins array, and set the registry's top-level generated field to the current UTC RFC 3339 timestamp in the same commit. Do not commit this file to the catalog; it lives here as the record of what was submitted.

entry.name: Mesh Messenger
entry.description: Read, send and reply to Meshtastic and MeshCore messages through Wi-Fi-connected LoRa nodes, in one inbox that keeps each network separate.
entry.author: KQ4WLR
